questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: A concave mirror produces a real, inverted image of the same size as the object. The object is placed at:
questions.explanation: When an object is placed at the centre of curvature (C = 2F), a concave mirror produces a real, inverted image of the same size at C.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: From the V-I graph shown, determine the resistance of the conductor.
questions.explanation: Resistance R = V/I = slope⁻¹ of V-I graph. From the graph, at V=10V the current I=2A. R = 10/2 = 5 Ω.
questions.imagePrompt: Clean physics V-I graph (Ohm's Law). X-axis: Current I (A) from 0 to 4. Y-axis: Voltage V (V) from 0 to 20. Straight line passing through origin with points (1,5), (2,10), (3,15). Grid lines shown. Title 'V-I Characteristics'. Professional lab-style graph.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: The dimensional formula of torque is:
questions.explanation: Torque τ = r × F. [τ] = [L] × [MLT⁻²] = [ML²T⁻²]. Same as energy/work.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: The magnetic field at the center of a solenoid of n turns per unit length carrying current I is:
questions.explanation: For a long solenoid, B = μ₀nI, where n is the number of turns per unit length.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: Which of the following has the highest lattice energy?
questions.explanation: Lattice energy increases with smaller ionic radii and higher charges. F⁻ is the smallest halide ion, so NaF has the highest lattice energy.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: Identify the type of isomerism exhibited by the two structures shown in the diagram.
questions.explanation: The two structures show cis (same side) and trans (opposite side) arrangement of groups around a C=C double bond. This is geometrical isomerism.
questions.imagePrompt: Clean chemistry diagram showing cis-trans isomerism of 2-butene. LEFT: cis-2-butene with both CH₃ groups on the same side of the C=C double bond. RIGHT: trans-2-butene with CH₃ groups on opposite sides. Double bond shown clearly. Labels 'cis' and 'trans'. Professional organic chemistry style.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: The gas that turns lime water milky is:
questions.explanation: CO₂ reacts with lime water Ca(OH)₂ to form insoluble CaCO₃ (white precipitate), making it milky: CO₂ + Ca(OH)₂ → CaCO₃↓ + H₂O.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: In periodic table, which property generally increases across a period from left to right?
questions.explanation: Electronegativity generally increases across a period (left to right) due to increasing nuclear charge with similar shielding.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: If A = {1, 2, 3} and B = {2, 3, 4}, then A ∪ B is:
questions.explanation: A ∪ B = all elements in A or B or both = {1, 2, 3, 4}.

questions.question: From the given graph, determine the period of the function f(x) = sin x.
questions.explanation: The sine function completes one full cycle over an interval of 2π. From the graph, the pattern repeats every 2π units.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: The functional unit of the kidney is:
questions.explanation: The nephron is the structural and functional unit of the kidney, responsible for filtering blood and producing urine.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: Identify the phase of mitosis shown in the diagram where chromosomes are aligned at the equatorial plate.
questions.explanation: In Metaphase, chromosomes are aligned at the metaphase plate (equatorial plate) of the cell, attached to spindle fibers at their centromeres.
questions.imagePrompt: Clean biology diagram of a cell in Metaphase of mitosis. Cell outline (oval). Spindle fibers extending from two poles (centrioles). Chromosomes (X-shaped, condensed) aligned at the center of the cell (metaphase plate). Label 'Identify the phase'. Professional cell biology style.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: Which part of the brain is responsible for memory and intelligence?
questions.explanation: The Cerebrum is the largest part of the brain and is responsible for higher brain functions like thinking, memory, reasoning, and intelligence.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: Which of the following is a viral disease?
questions.explanation: Influenza (flu) is caused by the Influenza virus. Cholera (Vibrio), Typhoid (Salmonella), and TB (Mycobacterium) are bacterial diseases.
